claims.evidence: Witness report shows an engine assembly with no readable brand/model markings; no Korean origin markings are visible.
No documentation, shipping/origin labels, or readable markings are shown in the witness observations.
Witness report describes visible components and wear/dust/grease but does not include any running test, video, or test results.
No audio/video of the engine running or teardown evidence is included in the witness report.
No mileage/usage history or odometer/ECU data is shown.
Witness report does not show seals/fasteners/teardown indicators or any proof of whether it was opened.

risks.risk: Engine make/model and engine code are not readable, so vehicle compatibility and exact part matching are unknown (wrong engine risk).
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate and any stamped markings on the block/head (plus a photo showing the full engine with markings in focus).
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unverified engine assembly with unknown compatibility (worst-case: buyer may need additional parts or it may not fit).

risks.risk: “Tested and working / no knock” is not evidenced; internal damage (bearing wear, cylinder wear, timing issues) may exist even if the engine looks complete.
risks.proof: A short video of the engine running (cold start if possible) or a compression/leak test sheet with readings.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst-case: treat as for parts/repair until test results are provided).

risks.risk: Missing or swapped components (sensors, brackets, covers, ECU, starter, injectors, turbo) may not be included; witness only confirms an assembly is present, not completeness.
risks.proof: A full inventory photo/clip laid out showing every included component, and a checklist photo of what is included (ECU/injectors/starter/alternator/turbo if applicable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown bundle (worst-case: buyer may have to source missing sensors/ECU/accessories).

risks.risk: Critical condition of timing components, cylinder head, crank bearings, and seals is not visible clearly; surface dust/grease does not confirm internal health.
risks.proof: Photos of timing area/cover condition (if accessible), cylinder head surface, and any visible seal condition; plus teardown indicators if it was never opened.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case internal condition (worst-case: assume wear and require overhaul).

risks.risk: Origin claims (Korean/Belgium/Tokunbo) are not supported by visible documentation; could be misrepresented.
risks.proof: Photos of import documents, invoice, or labels/serials that tie to Belgium/Tokunbo, and any brand/model plates.
risks.if_unproven: Price without origin premium (worst-case: treat as generic used engine assembly).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up photo of the engine code/ID plate and any stamped markings on the block/head (in focus).
Send a video of the engine running (or cold start) showing no abnormal knocking, plus a short audio clip.
Provide compression test and/or leak-down test results (with readings) and any fault codes if available.
Confirm what is included: ECU, starter, alternator, injectors, turbo (if applicable), sensors, and all brackets/covers—show an inventory photo of every item included.
Provide proof of origin (import documents/invoice or labels) if claiming Tokunbo/Belgium/Korean parts.
response.reason: The witness can confirm it is an engine assembly, but the make/model/engine code and working/test evidence are not readable or shown. Without those, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
